title: Why The 24-Year ISS Era Ends On Purpose
hook: NASA will spend $843 million to push the ISS down.
closing: The ISS ends because aging orbit costs money, and its replacement choices shape what humans do next.
question: What should replace the ISS?

segments.say: The ISS has carried people continuously for 24 years, turning one station into humanity's longest-running home in orbit.
The ISS costs NASA $3 billion each year, making retirement part of the mission's financial reality.
NASA's ISS deorbit vehicle contract is $843 million, paying for the final push that will bring the station down safely.
